evidence: empty_void: payoff@-0.4 (t=28.93s) is an empty dark-navy frame with nothing but Data holding a blank price tag in the lower third. The video ends on wasted, empty space.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg3:start, seg3:mid and seg3:end Data stands in the doorway of 'THE CROWN' while a grey shutter slides a little way across the window by itself as the number goes 67% → 64% → 61%. The change in the picture is barely visible, and the full and empty glasses in the bottom-right corner are never explained. The closing (seg4) reuses this exact scene with Data still idle, and the video ends on a dark void with a blank price tag (payoff@-0.4).
weakest_scene.root_cause: The shutter has no agent, so Data is placed beside the moving part rather than driving it. Mapped onto a whole window, 67→61 is too small a change to read at a glance, and the ending falls through to the default empty host plate.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make Data the cause. He hauls the shutter down by its handle with a two-hand grip, or pulls pints off a tap row as each drinker leaves. Draw the 2001-2003 level as a big ghost or then-mark right on the shutter so the drop reads at a glance. Drop or explain the corner glasses, give the closing its own full-frame finished picture (not the seg3 plate reused), and remove the empty price-tag tail frame.
